name: Matsubara Sana
source:
Sana is a part-time waitress at the Sakuragi's cake shop. She's still in high school and she's a year younger than [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url]. Most of the time she's a very down-to-earth girl. However, she has a massive crush on her boss [url=https://vndb.org/c27885]Takashi[/url], and she gets very emotional and protective when other women come around asking for him. Other than that, she is a very energetic and honest girl.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and [url=https://www.jastusa.com/target-pheromone.html]JAST USA[/url]]
